method: Keyword-driven web discovery. Every entrant is a fetched homepage; name and description come from that page's own metadata. Listicles and articles are excluded, as are the 7 tracked products and 92 known incumbents. Classification and threat score are derived ONLY from what each product publishes about itself — never from the keyword that surfaced it — and every signal records the phrase it matched.

delivery.reason: Email delivery is NOT configured. Add SMTP_HOST, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS, SMTP_FROM (or SMTP_USER) to .env. For Microsoft 365 use SMTP_HOST=smtp.office365.com SMTP_PORT=587 with an account that has SMTP AUTH enabled; for Google Workspace use smtp.gmail.com:587 with an App Password. Until then each digest is generated and stored under data/digests/ but not delivered.
